# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.80

This release adds the Shadow Oracle character set inspired by the supplied drawing and makes the new equipment available inside the game.

## Added

- Blue, purple, and red light sabers in the shop.
- A HUD equipment control for selecting a purchased saber and turning its blade on or off.
- Glowing 3D saber rendering that follows the player and hides while sleeping or driving.
- The animated Hovering Void Orb pet with bobbing movement, tendrils, a glow ring, and an illuminated eye.
- The Shadow Oracle outfit with long black hair, dark visor, purple-black jacket, skirt, and boots.
- Complete outfit and pet patches in the shop inventory system.
- Unit coverage for outfit, pet, and light-saber equipment behaviour.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.80-debug.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`

## Validation

- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Vitest unit tests
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync
- Android debug APK assembly

## Installation note

This is an unsigned debug APK intended for direct testing. Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser or file manager. Play Store release signing remains a separate step.
